title: Pawnstorm - A chess-based puzzle roguelite
author: matthojo
selftext:
TLDR; my 11yr son and I vibe coded a chess-based puzzle roguelite game in a week. I’m actually really proud of what we’ve got so far, and we would love for others to have a play.

[https://trypawnstorm.online](https://trypawnstorm.online)

—

My son has recently taught himself how to play chess, and subsequently ended up teaching me.  
We’ve been interested in making a game together for the better part of a year, and this felt like a good excuse to have some fun!  
We just went with whatever we wanted to add in, from different levels, bosses, commanders, skins, power ups, we just kept going… 😃 we’ve had to chill the brakes a little bit as it started to feel more fleshed out.  
We’ve been playing this almost daily for the last 2 weeks, and he asked if I’d “send it to other people” to have others play it .. so here I am!

I’m also more than happy to answer any questions on the workflow if it’s of any use to anyone.

—

**Agents**

**Code:** Opus 5.5 orchestrator with Sonnet sub-agents  
**Images:** Codex via Claude Code with GPT 5.5  
**Music/SFX:** ElevenLabs via Claude Code  
**3D Model:** Blender via Claude Code

**Stack**

\- Typescript  
\- Netlify  
\- Clerk

comments.body:
I'm building an AI game platform, one that allows players to join from any device, like for example, use their phones as controllers and play on a shared TV, or 4x ppl joining remotely from their laptops, etc

[pwned.games](http://pwned.games/)

Would this interest you?

You can choose to sell it to a host that can bring other co-op players for free, or everyone needs to buy the game, or let it be free, or free if they own a pass and you get a share of the revenue from pass sales.
